result.stdout:
Usage:
  blitzbridge --transport stdio --config <path>
  blitzbridge --transport http [--dashboard] [--urls <url>]
  blitzbridge --init-config [--config <path>]

Options:
  --transport <http|stdio>  Select transport mode (default: http).
  --config <path>           Profiles JSON path. Required for stdio if default file does not exist.
  --init-config             Create a sample profiles config and exit.
  --dashboard               Enable hosted dashboard routes in HTTP mode.
  --help, -h                Show this help text and exit.
